optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Embedded Software Engineer, Charging Station Firmware

professionalSummary.text: Seasoned firmware engineer with 14 OTA releases to a fleet of 3,200+ public charging stations, consistently meeting operational and quality standards.
professionalSummary.witness: Released fourteen firmware versions over the air to the installed fleet of about 3,200 public charging stations between 2022 and 2025, each in rollout waves agreed with the operations centre and each under a release ticket in my name.

professionalSummary.text: Proven on‑call field support, having resolved a fleet‑wide fault in October 2023 and maintaining high session success rates post‑release.
professionalSummary.witness: Watched the charging session success rate on the fleet dashboard after each release wave and held the field on-call for the station faults the operations centre raised; the fleet‑wide fault of October 2023, when a connector firmware bug stopped sessions on one station model, was handled on my on‑call shift and is recorded in the operations incident log.

professionalSummary.text: Expert in coordinating release waves with operations, documenting responsibilities and ensuring clear hand‑offs.
professionalSummary.witness: Coordinated the rollout waves for each release with the operations centre, recording in the release ticket which checks were mine and which belonged to the operations centre's wave sign‑off.

professionalSummary.text: Rigorous hardware‑in‑the‑loop testing, with documented test records attached to every release ticket.
professionalSummary.witness: Tested each firmware version on the hardware‑in‑the‑loop rig before release, with the rig test record attached to the release ticket.

professionalSummary.text: Clear, comprehensive release notes detailing limitations and hand‑over conditions for field technicians.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the release notes for each version, listing the known limitations on the older station models and the hand‑over conditions for the field technicians.

experienceHighlights.text: Managed 14 OTA firmware releases across 3,200+ stations, ensuring zero downtime and high session success rates.
experienceHighlights.witness: Released fourteen firmware versions over the air to the installed fleet of about 3,200 public charging stations between 2022 and 2025, each in rollout waves agreed with the operations centre and each under a release ticket in my name.

experienceHighlights.text: Resolved a fleet‑wide connector firmware bug during on‑call shift, documented in incident log.
experienceHighlights.witness: The fleet‑wide fault of October 2023, when a connector firmware bug stopped sessions on one station model, was handled on my on‑call shift and is recorded in the operations incident log.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated release wave schedules with operations, delineating responsibilities in release tickets.
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated the rollout waves for each release with the operations centre, recording in the release ticket which checks were mine and which belonged to the operations centre's wave sign‑off.

experienceHighlights.text: Performed HIL testing for every firmware version, attaching rig test records to release tickets.
experienceHighlights.witness: Tested each firmware version on the hardware‑in‑the‑loop rig before release, with the rig test record attached to the release ticket.

experienceHighlights.text: Authored detailed release notes with limitations and hand‑over conditions for field techs.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the release notes for each version, listing the known limitations on the older station models and the hand‑over conditions for the field technicians.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Release tickets and rig test records for the last five firmware versions, plus the October 2023 incident log.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the release tickets for the last five versions with their rig test records and wave plans, and the operations incident log record for the October 2023 fleet‑wide fault.

skills.witness: Released fourteen firmware versions over the air to the installed fleet of about 3,200 public charging stations between 2022 and 2025, each in rollout waves agreed with the operations centre and each under a release ticket in my name.
